questions.question: Explain the difference between a line segment, a ray and a straight line.
questions.expected_answer: A segment has two endpoints and a measurable length; a ray has one endpoint and goes on forever in one direction; a line has no endpoints and goes on forever in both directions.

questions.question: Define parallel and perpendicular lines and give their symbols and diagram markings.
questions.expected_answer: Parallel lines never meet and stay the same distance apart (∥, matching arrowheads). Perpendicular lines meet at 90° (⊥, a small square at the intersection).

questions.question: Describe the sides of rectangle ABCD using the words parallel and perpendicular.
questions.expected_answer: AB ∥ DC and AD ∥ BC; adjacent sides are perpendicular, e.g. AB ⊥ BC.
